name: M3_MMS037MI_LstPlanPolicy
description: List planning policies and view their detailed parameters for material planning and order control. A planning policy groups rules that determine how M3 generates planned orders, action messages, and warning messages for purchase, manufacturing, and distribution. Each returned record includes basic identity data (company, planning policy code, name, description) together with many settings that govern default order statuses, planning horizons and fences, rescheduling thresholds, reorder‑point logic, shelf‑life handling, long‑term planning, and integration with advanced planning or scheduling tools. Use this read-only operation to retrieve the current configuration of planning behavior so that user interfaces, reports, or external systems can display or analyze how items will be planned under a given policy.

inputParameters.name: PLCD
inputParameters.description: Planning policy code used to filter which planning policy records are listed.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the planning policy record.

outputParameters.name: PLCD
outputParameters.description: Planning policy code that groups rules for generating planned orders and action messages.

outputParameters.name: TX15
outputParameters.description: Short name for the planning policy.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Description of the planning policy.

outputParameters.name: PUSL
outputParameters.description: Lowest purchase order status to use when releasing planned purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: WHST
outputParameters.description: Default manufacturing order status used when releasing planned manufacturing orders.

outputParameters.name: TRSL
outputParameters.description: Lowest distribution or requisition order line status used when releasing planned distribution orders.

outputParameters.name: WHSM
outputParameters.description: Default work order status used when releasing planned work orders.

outputParameters.name: STN1
outputParameters.description: Status to assign planned orders that receive action message A1 (release and reschedule).

outputParameters.name: RSC9
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether orders are released on the planning date or on an alternate planning date.

outputParameters.name: STNP
outputParameters.description: Status to assign automatically created planned orders.

outputParameters.name: FQPP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether planned orders inside the planning time fence are firmed by setting them to status 15.

outputParameters.name: EXPM
outputParameters.description: Controls whether planned orders with action messages for master-scheduled items are exploded into component requirements.

outputParameters.name: AFUH
outputParameters.description: Number of days before the planning time fence when planned orders are automatically firmed.

outputParameters.name: CHMP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether planned manufacturing orders in status 20 are re-exploded when the product structure changes.

outputParameters.name: UMMO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether existing manufacturing orders are updated when the product structure is changed.

outputParameters.name: DRIM
outputParameters.description: Accepted delay in days before the system proposes rescheduling an order to an earlier date.

outputParameters.name: DROM
outputParameters.description: Accepted delay in days before the system proposes rescheduling an order to a later date.

outputParameters.name: ALEA
outputParameters.description: Amount threshold used to decide whether to create action messages to reschedule an order to a later date.

outputParameters.name: GODM
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether action messages are generated for delayed orders based on the delay time filter.

outputParameters.name: DODN
outputParameters.description: Number of days an order may be delayed before an "order delayed" action message is generated.

outputParameters.name: GOWD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether action messages are generated for expected order delays based on the delay time filter.

outputParameters.name: DODM
outputParameters.description: Number of days an order may be late before an "order delay" action message is generated.

outputParameters.name: ORMH
outputParameters.description: Number of days before the order start date that the release date is set.

outputParameters.name: RCLQ
outputParameters.description: Controls how planned order quantities are recalculated in a bucket when using order policy 15.

outputParameters.name: SSPF
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether safety stock is compared with projected on-hand balance at the planning fence when generating action messages.

outputParameters.name: RPTA
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether reorder point and priority value are compared with available total when generating action messages.

outputParameters.name: RPCA
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether reorder point is compared with projected on-hand balance at the planning fence.

outputParameters.name: SRAC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether a reorder point calculation is triggered when reorder point minus available at lead time exceeds the economic order quantity.

outputParameters.name: SQOQ
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether shortage quantity is included when calculating the proposed order quantity.

outputParameters.name: NREP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether non-representative reservations are deducted from planned on-hand balance before checking action messages.

outputParameters.name: UPPR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether items with zero or negative priority values automatically generate planned orders.

outputParameters.name: MXDR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether excess stock above maximum balance generates planned distribution order returns.

outputParameters.name: MRPS
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether reorder point items are treated as MRP-planned items during simulation.

outputParameters.name: FXRC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether reorder point calculations are restricted to fixed reorder cycle dates.

outputParameters.name: LS90
outputParameters.description: Amount limit above which planned purchase orders are not automatically released.

outputParameters.name: FACH
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether forecast alarms are checked when creating planned orders.

outputParameters.name: MPI6
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether items with manual planning values are stopped with a special status and message instead of normal processing.

outputParameters.name: ARCO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether released planned orders are archived in a separate file when they are closed.

outputParameters.name: ATPA
outputParameters.description: Number of days added to the planning time fence or lead time when calculating available-to-promise.

outputParameters.name: SUPO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether requirements within the planning time fence are summarized into one planned order for items with order policy 12.

outputParameters.name: APPC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether APP/M3 SWB material synchronization is activated for items using this planning policy.

outputParameters.name: RRMC
outputParameters.description: Indicates when run-out time and priority values are recalculated in relation to material plan changes.

outputParameters.name: RPPH
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether planned orders outside the planning horizon are automatically deleted.

outputParameters.name: PRPT
outputParameters.description: Defines when in the time bucket planned orders are created for order policy 15.

outputParameters.name: CSHL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether shelf life or last sales date is considered in MRP through expiration reclassification transactions.

outputParameters.name: IAPS
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether APS planning tools are integrated into the MRP process using preallocations.

outputParameters.name: PLVL
outputParameters.description: Defines the item level on which MRP is performed, such as item or item/attribute level.

outputParameters.name: DRED
outputParameters.description: Number of working days to delay releasing a planned order after the last issue date. This is used to allow for potential returns and avoid unnecessary replenishment.

outputParameters.name: LPHZ
outputParameters.description: Number of days covered by long-term requirements planning when long-term planning is activated. It extends or replaces the standard planning horizon for long-term MRP runs.

outputParameters.name: PLHA
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the planning horizon is adjusted by or replaced with the specified number of days.

outputParameters.name: IMOQ
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether maximum order quantity is ignored outside the planning time fence during MRP or ROP calculation.

outputParameters.name: SAGR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether agreement searches for alternate suppliers are limited to within the planning time fence.
